sloka: निहतास्ते महावीर्या रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।राक्षसाः सुमहाकाया नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः।अन्ये च बहवः शूरा महात्मानो निपातिताः ।। ६.७२.४ ।।
transliteration: nihatāste mahāvīryā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā।rākṣasāḥ sumahākāyā nānāśastraviśāradāḥ।anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā mahātmāno nipātitāḥ ।। 6.72.4 ।।

translations.english: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."
translations.hindi: उसकी भुजाओं ओर गरदन के कट जाने से उसके शरीर से बहुत सा रुघिर निकला था । उसूका पर्वत के समान मस्तक लङ्का के द्वार को रोके हुए अब भी पड़ा हे
